full_review_scope: Read all 136 original nonretail paragraphs, all 105 original cited exact own-date headlines, and each replacement/additional headline. Compared every quoted market figure with the own card for exact instrument, value, session, unit and horizon; all 85 quoted card fields across 17 paragraphs match, including Treasury yields/changes/spread/curve and completed UTC crypto daily observations. Directional descriptions and individual exchange references also checked. Company news/previews use seven days, results fourteen, macro thirty-five by meaning; August results remain within their result window, with macro-policy baselines evaluated separately. No numeric spot FX, suppressed WDC/CMCSA levels, absent-listing metrics, future policy/election outcome, fabricated flows/ownership/social counts or Polish-sector-company leakage remains.
pending_event_review: August US CPI was released before the September 12 cutoff and is treated as completed. September 11 debate commentary is post-event while the election remains pending. Four scenarios are unresolved Fed, ECB, BOE and possible East Coast port disruption. No September 12 ECB actual is admitted. GameStop September 10 after-close results/filing are compared with September 11 completed trading, not the earlier regular session. Adobe Firefly announcement remains a product catalyst, not an earnings outcome; TSMC High-NA installation is prospective.
limits: This is an AI review of frozen headlines and retrospectively retrieved market data, not article-body research, external verification of every underlying report, or certification of original unrevised publisher/data vintage. Source acceptance does not grant blanket semantic approval. Ambiguous or unsupported event status was removed rather than upgraded to a completed fact. Review used September 12 own-date evidence after finishing September 11; no later source/card/spec or own authored September 2–5 report was opened.
